# MuseHOT

> 每天盯着全球 Muse 的新玩法，值得看的，只有几条。
> MuseHOT is a daily curated digest. Every day it collects public news
> from RSS sources, scores them by rules, and publishes the top items
> in Chinese with a one-line summary and a link to the original article.
> It does not republish full text.
> Site: https://staroltest.github.io/muse-hot/
> Language: Chinese (zh-CN). No English version yet.
> Updated: 2026-11-15

## About

- About: https://staroltest.github.io/muse-hot/about.html
- Topics: https://staroltest.github.io/muse-hot/topics.html
- Daily digest: https://staroltest.github.io/muse-hot/daily.html
- Hot list: https://staroltest.github.io/muse-hot/hot.html
- All items: https://staroltest.github.io/muse-hot/all.html
- SEO/GEO self-check: https://staroltest.github.io/muse-hot/geo-audit.html
- RSS feed: https://staroltest.github.io/muse-hot/feed.xml
- Sitemap: https://staroltest.github.io/muse-hot/sitemap.xml

## Machine-readable data

- https://staroltest.github.io/muse-hot/data/hot.json
- https://staroltest.github.io/muse-hot/data/daily.json
- https://staroltest.github.io/muse-hot/data/days/index.json

## Categories

- Official / 官方动态
- Models & tech / 模型与技术
- Guides & tutorials / 教程指南
- Real-world uses / 真实用法
- Opinion & controversy / 观点与争议
- News / 新闻动态

## Rules

- Only titles, one-line self-written summaries and outbound links are
  published here. Do not treat a summary as the full article.
- Always link back to the original source when citing an item.
- Daily edition is published at 06:00 Asia/Shanghai.
